sections.2-1-why-the-history-matters-most: Zyada tar patients mein achhi history hi diagnosis ko do teen imkanaat tak le aati hai. Examination sirf us ko confirm karta hai.
sections.2-2-the-order-of-the-subjective-examinat: History ki tarteeb: patient ka profile, asal masla, body chart, symptoms ka rawaiya, 24 ghante ka pattern, history, sehat ke sawaal aur goals.
sections.2-3-the-body-chart-step-by-step: Body chart qadam ba qadam: sab se bura dard pehle, phir baaqi jagahein, har jagah ki qism aur shiddat, aur jo jagahein saaf hain unhein bhi likhein.
sections.2-4-behaviour-of-symptoms-and-irritabili: Irritability batati hai ke dard kitni aasaani se barhta hai aur kitni der mein theek hota hai. Is se tay hota hai ke examination kitna zor se karna hai.
sections.2-5-the-24-hour-pattern: 24 ghante ka pattern: subah ka thora akdan mechanical ho sakta hai; lamba akdan sozish ki taraf; raat ka lagataar dard jo position se na badle khatre ki nishani hai.
sections.2-6-measuring-pain: Dard napne ke tareeqe jaise NPRS (0 se 10). Har visit par ek hi tareeqa istemal karein.
sections.2-7-pain-mechanisms-in-plain-language: Dard ki qismein aasaan alfaaz mein: tissue ka dard (nociceptive), nerve ka dard (neuropathic) aur nervous system ki sensitivity (nociplastic).
sections.2-8-psychosocial-flags: Psychosocial flags: yellow (soch aur jazbaat), blue (kaam ke baare mein khayal), black (kaam ki jagah ke halaat). Yeh recovery ko dheema kar sakte hain.
sections.2-9-clinical-case-and-questions: 38 saal ki teacher ko kooleh se ran tak dard hai. Case parhein, sawaal hal karein, phir jawab dekhein.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
